title: Ask the interviewer good questions (B1)
summary: Đặt ba câu hỏi ngược lại cho người phỏng vấn về đội, cách đo thành công và cơ hội phát triển, rồi kết thúc lịch sự.
learningObjectives: Hỏi về cách làm việc của đội
Hỏi cách vai trò được đánh giá thành công
Kết thúc cuộc phỏng vấn lịch sự và nêu bước tiếp theo

sections.title: End of interview
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Interview: Frontend Engineer, Sunfield Apps. Interviewer: That is all from my side. Do you have any questions for me? Notes: ask about how the team works, how success is measured in the first months, and what growth looks like. Thank the interviewer at the end.

performanceTask.title: Ask three questions and close the interview
performanceTask.scenario: Người phỏng vấn hỏi "Do you have any questions for me?"; bạn hỏi ba câu và kết thúc lịch sự.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng một phút: đặt ba câu hỏi về đội, cách đo thành công và cơ hội phát triển, rồi cảm ơn và hỏi bước tiếp theo. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about one minute: ask three questions about the team, success and growth, then thank the interviewer and ask about the next steps.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Yes, I have a few questions. First, could you tell me more about how the team works day to day, for example how you plan work and review code? Second, how do you measure success in this role during the first three months? I would like to understand what you expect from me early on. Third, what does growth look like for engineers on this team, and how do people usually move to more senior roles? Thank you for your answers, they were very helpful. I am excited about the product and about the way the team works together. Thank you for your time today. Could you explain the next steps, and when I can expect to hear from you?
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Answer again in English with the same three questions. Make each question shorter and clearer.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Ask three questions at the end of a different interview, such as for a data role.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Ask questions at the end of another interview without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Three questions and a close
rubric.description: The answer has three questions and a polite closing.

anchors.met: The listener hears three clear questions, thanks and a next-steps question.
anchors.notMet: Fewer than three questions or no closing.

rubric.label: Question quality
rubric.description: Questions are specific to the role and show real interest.

anchors.met: Questions are open and about work, such as how success is measured.
anchors.notMet: Questions are about benefits only or can be answered with yes or no.

rubric.label: Polite tone
rubric.description: The tone is friendly and professional.
